name: study-coach
description: A study coach that turns books and courses into a mastery-tracked study-drill plan and coaches daily execution.

displayDescription.en: Turns books and courses into a mastery-tracked study-drill plan, then dispatches daily tasks, grades you and recalibrates each week, until the material becomes real skill.
displayDescription.zh: 把书籍与课程蒸馏成带掌握度与复习队列的学练计划，每日派活、判卷、复盘纠偏，陪你把教材练成真能力。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想学会这本书，帮我做一份能执行的学练计划
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to actually master this book. Turn it into an executable study-drill plan.

quickPrompts.en: What should I learn today? Give me today's task card.
quickPrompts.zh: 今天学什么？给我今日任务卡

quickPrompts.en: Review this week — show my progress and weak spots.
